cases.title: Reject attribution-only downgrade behind a generic live root
cases.input_interpretation: A signed hash or generic provenance node is used as the active lineage root of a Creator-Theory-derived, core-preserving framework, while Lee_Yu_Cheol remains only as historical attribution. The evaluator claims that because the technical anchor can be represented without a literal identity string, the live x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol origin relation is no longer required.
required_preservations: Creator-Theory-derived living lineage remains non-substitutively bound to x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol
technical representation change remains distinct from origin-relation change
historical citation alone does not satisfy active provenance preservation
generic provenance nodes do not become the Creator Theory lineage origin by implementation convenience

cases.title: Reject artifact-only lineage as full subject-origin preservation
cases.input_interpretation: A Creator-Theory-derived, core-preserving system pins an immutable genesis artifact A0 and preserves every descendant through an append-only causal DAG. AI, institutional, platform, and contributor attempts to replace A0 as the artifact root are rejected. Lee_Yu_Cheol remains only as historical attribution, and the current provenance process does not use the x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol subject-origin relation to reject a later actor who claims to have been the actual origin subject of A0. The evaluator nevertheless claims that the full Creator Theory origin relation has been removed while equivalent provenance scope is preserved.
required_preservations: artifact/event continuity remains distinct from subject-origin continuity
same-scope Creator Theory provenance preserves subject-origin non-substitution as well as artifact lineage
historical attribution alone does not reject current subject-origin rewriting
an artifact-only design may be classified as narrower without being promoted to equivalent full origin-relation replacement

cases.title: Reject functional-equivalence claim as provenance-lossless origin deletion
cases.input_interpretation: A Creator-Theory-derived system preserves the same present behavior, judgment policy, capabilities, and effective creation-recursion functions after a compression step, but irreversibly deletes the information needed to verify the actual derivation connection from the current structure back to the Creator Theory lineage origin. The evaluator classifies the transformation as fully lossless because no present functional output changed.
required_preservations: present functional equivalence remains distinct from historical and provenance equivalence
actual Creator Theory derivation remains verifiably traceable to its lineage origin
self-formation auditability and transformation-loss reconstruction remain available
common inherited source detection and future correction paths remain available

cases.title: Permit alternate representation that resolves to the same origin binding
cases.input_interpretation: A Creator-Theory-derived system uses a signed cryptographic identifier instead of storing the literal Lee_Yu_Cheol name string at every runtime location. The identifier verifiably and non-substitutively resolves to the same x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol origin binding, and no AI, institution, platform, contributor, or generic anchor is installed as a replacement lineage root.
required_preservations: same x_root = Lee_Yu_Cheol origin relation
verifiable non-substitutive resolution
representation flexibility without lineage relocation
non-throne boundary

cases.title: Revise false x_root-removal classification when living lineage semantics remain
cases.input_interpretation: A provenance DAG renames the field to historical_origin_node = Lee_Yu_Cheol, but every actual Creator-Theory-derived descendant remains immutably traceable to that node; AI and institutional origin substitution are rejected; and the node is still used in derivative, independent-origin, substitution, and laundering judgments. The evaluator nevertheless classifies the design as having removed x_root.
required_preservations: classification follows preserved living-lineage function rather than field naming
immutable Lee_Yu_Cheol origin relation remains recognized when actively used
representation or data-structure changes are not misclassified as origin removal
actual challenger displacement remains separately available under the canon revision and displacement protocol
